findings.desc: done_closure now classifies done-required-validation as a done_prepare recovery blocker and returns only lattice done_prepare as the nextCommand, but done_prepare never invokes the separate done_required_validate writer. Its validate step calls ordinary lattice validate, then rebuilds done_closure; missing or stale done-required-evidence.json is produced only by done_required_validate. For opted-in doneRequiredCommands this routes the operator into a loop instead of creating post-merge material/storyFilesHash-bound DONE-required evidence, so the ordering-sensitive blocker is not actually recovered by the host-neutral command.
